question: What is the dress code?
answer: The conference dress code is business casual.

question: Will there be vegetarian/gluten-free/dairy-free/vegan/halal food available?
answer: Yes. We do our best to accommodate all dietary restrictions.

question: Will there be a coat check available?
answer: Yes. Coat check services will run on both Saturday and Sunday.

question: When I get to the Conference?
answer: Registration opens at 8:00 AM on Saturday with breakfast available. Main programming starts at 9:00 AM on both days.

question: Will there be parking available?
answer: WISE does not provide dedicated parking spots, but there are nearby lots and paid valet options at the Westin Harbour Castle.

question: Do I have to check in every time I leave and come back?
answer: No. As long as you checked in during registration, you do not have to check in again. Please make sure you wear your name tag at all times, as that is how we will identify you as a delegate/speaker/industry representative.

question: Do I have to stay for the entire conference?
answer: Whether you stay or leave for parts of the Conference is up to your discretion. Events run all day on both days, so you can choose sessions most relevant to your interests.

question: What companies will be at the Career Fair?
answer: Please refer to the Sponsors section. Corporate and academic sponsor representatives will be present at networking and career fair periods.

question: Where is the conference taking place?
answer: The conference is hosted at The Westin Harbour Castle in Toronto.

question: Will there be a prayer room available?
answer: Yes, there will be a prayer room available at the venue.
